narrative: All upstream and downstream dependencies are in a healthy state for this release. Completion and integration-validation data shows that dependent systems have finished their work and the integration points have been formally tested. There are no dependencies classified as FAILED or BLOCKING, which means no gate conditions are triggered from this dimension. The integration-validation pass rate of 100% is the strongest possible signal that the interfaces between systems will behave correctly in production. Dependencies that were tracked as IN_PROGRESS at the last snapshot have since been completed and validated. The dependency landscape is clean and does not introduce any release risk.
